preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of cities in each test case is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The significance of each city is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases won't exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of cities across all test cases is at most 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if it's impossible to connect all cities, or a non-negative integer representing the minimum total length of roads to connect all cities.

postconditions.expression: if output != -1 then all cities are connected
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then all cities are connected by roads that satisfy the given bitwise AND condition.
